prompt.generated_prompt_string: Hyper-realistic, ultra-detailed close-up portrait of the left half of an adult woman's face submerged in water. One eye is in sharp focus. Light rays create caustic reflections and fluid patterns across her skin. Tiny suspended water droplets and bubbles add depth. Her dark hair is visible on the right side, extending into the water. Keep her expression calm and serene with an intense focused gaze. Use underwater macro portrait photography, shallow depth of field, physically plausible refraction, cinematic soft shadows with crisp highlights, and portrait 3:4 framing. Emphasize textures and the interplay of light, water, and natural skin without rendered text.
